NBP's monetary policy supports the consolidation of economic recovery following the pandemic-induced recession and stabilises inflation at the level consistent with the NBP's inflation target in the medium term.

Taking into account the sources of currently elevated inflation and the expected temporary nature of higher inflation, while considering also the uncertainty about the robustness and scale of the economic recovery, NBP is keeping interest rates unchanged.
